require 'json';require 'digest';require 'fileutils';require 'open3'
o=File.expand_path(__dir__);base=File.expand_path('../nested-row-candidate-2026-10-30',o);sha=->(p){Digest::SHA256.file(p).hexdigest}
raise 'existing result' if File.exist?(o+'/report.json')
receipt=JSON.parse(File.read(base+'/acceptance-receipt.json'));raise 'unaccepted baseline' unless receipt['status']=='accepted'
receipt['evidence_hashes'].each{|p,h|raise 'baseline drift' unless sha.call(base+'/'+p)==h}
r={status:'running',pid:Process.pid,runtime:'b1bf786',identities:[__FILE__,base+'/candidate-kujo',base+'/task-allocation-probe',base+'/acceptance-receipt.json'].to_h{|p|[p,sha.call(p)]},sources:{},rows:[],semantics:[]}
save=->{File.write(o+'/report.json.tmp',JSON.pretty_generate(r)+"\n");File.rename(o+'/report.json.tmp',o+'/report.json')};save.call
begin
 %w[dict struct deep-dict].product(%w[insertion dense repeated],[8,128],[1,8]).each do |shape,form,width,calls|
  dir=o+"/fixtures/#{shape}-#{form}-#{width}-#{calls}";FileUtils.mkdir_p(dir)
  leaf='{'+(0...width).map{|i|"\"#{i}\":0"}.join(',')+'}'
  root,path=case shape;when 'dict';['{"inner":'+leaf+'}','state["inner"]'];when 'struct';['Holder { row:'+leaf+' }','state.row'];else;['{"inner":{"leaf":'+leaf+'}}','state["inner"]["leaf"]'];end
  writes=case form
  when 'insertion';"#{path}[\"new-array\"]=[n] #{path}[\"new-dict\"]={\"v\":n}"
  when 'dense';"mut j:=0 while j<#{width} { #{path}[j]=[n+j] j+=1 }"
  else;"mut j:=0 while j<64 { #{path}[0]=[n+j] #{path}[1]={\"v\":n+j} j+=1 }"
  end
  check=case form
  when 'insertion';'assert_equal(row["new-array"],[n]) assert_equal(row["new-dict"],{"v":n})'
  when 'dense';"mut j:=0 while j<#{width} { assert_equal(row[j],[n+j]) j+=1 }"
  else;'assert_equal(row[0],[n+63]) assert_equal(row[1],{"v":n+63})'
  end
  untouched=form=='insertion' ? '0' : '2'
  check+=" mut k:=#{untouched} while k<#{width} { assert_equal(row[k],0) k+=1 }" unless form=='dense'
  owner="mut state:=#{root}\nexport func snapshot(){return #{path}}\nexport func update(n){#{writes} return n}\n"
  expected_len=width+(form=='insertion' ? 2 : 0)
  main="from owner import snapshot,update\nfunc verify(row,n){#{check} assert_equal(len(row),#{expected_len})}\nlet original:=snapshot() mut n:=1 while n<=#{calls} { let saved:=snapshot() assert_equal(update(n),n) if n==1 {assert_equal(saved,original)} else {verify(saved,n-1)} verify(snapshot(),n) n+=1 }\nassert_equal(len(original),#{width}) mut k:=0 while k<#{width} {assert_equal(original[k],0) k+=1} print(\"NESTED BOUNDARY PASS\")\n"
  File.write(dir+'/owner.kujo',owner);File.write(dir+'/main.kujo',main)
  %w[owner main].each{|name|p=dir+'/'+name+'.kujo';r[:sources][p]={sha256:sha.call(p),source:File.read(p)}}
  meta={shape:shape,form:form,width:width,calls:calls,path:dir+'/main.kujo'}
  %w[vm jit].each do |mode|
   argv=[base+'/task-allocation-probe',mode,meta[:path]];out,err,s=Open3.capture3(*argv);m=err.match(/requests=(\d+) requested_bytes=(\d+)/);raise out+err unless s.success?&&m&&out=="NESTED BOUNDARY PASS\n"
   r[:rows]<<meta.merge(mode:mode,argv:argv,stdout:out,stderr:err,exit:s.exitstatus,requests:m[1].to_i,bytes:m[2].to_i)
  end
  %w[vm interpreter jit].each do |mode|
   argv=[base+'/candidate-kujo','run',meta[:path],'--untrusted','--scheduler-no-timeout']+(mode=='vm' ? [] : ['--'+mode]);out,err,s=Open3.capture3(*argv);raise out+err unless s.success?&&out=="NESTED BOUNDARY PASS\n"
   r[:semantics]<<meta.merge(mode:mode,argv:argv,stdout:out,stderr:err,exit:s.exitstatus)
  end
  save.call
 end
 raise 'coverage' unless r[:rows].size==72&&r[:semantics].size==108
 r[:identities].each{|p,h|raise 'identity drift' unless sha.call(p)==h};r[:sources].each{|p,v|raise 'fixture drift' unless sha.call(p)==v[:sha256]}
 r[:status]='measured';save.call;puts '72 allocation observations /108 runtime semantics'
rescue=>e;r[:status]='failed';r[:error]=e.message;save.call;raise
end
